periods.description: The state founded after the Arcadia Empire's overthrow, ruled by Queen Raffi and symbolized by Princess Lisha.
periods.history: Created five years before volume 1 through the anti-imperial coup led by Earl Atismata; it inherits the challenge of replacing old empire institutions while protecting citizens from Abyss and remnants.
periods.goals: Maintain national stability, defend Crossfield and the capital, train female Drag-Knights, control ruins, and suppress old empire remnants.
periods.structure: Queen Raffi rules at the capital; Princess Lisha serves as symbolic royal; military, guard forces, academies, and frontier fortresses support state security.
